title: Dora AI
tagline: Dora AI: Your AI-powered travel companion! 🚀 Plan trips, earn crypto rewards, and turn social media inspiration into real itineraries. #TravelToEarn #AITravel
description:
Dora AI is a modern travel planning platform that combines artificial intelligence with social media integration and blockchain rewards. The application offers three core features:

1. AI-Powered Trip Planning
- Smart itinerary generation based on user preferences
- Adaptive scheduling and personalised recommendations

2. Social Media Integration
- Converts travel content from social media into actionable travel plans
- Allows users to create bucket lists from their favorite travel reels

3. Travel-to-Earn System
- Rewards users with cryptocurrency for their travels
- Gamifies the travel experience with incentive mechanisms

The platform uses Privy for secure authentication, supporting multiple login methods including email, Google, Apple, Twitter, and TikTok using Privy.io. The UI features a modern gradient design with responsive components, making it accessible across all devices.

Target users include tech-savvy travelers who want to streamline their trip planning while earning rewards and leveraging social media inspiration for their adventures.
how_its_made: Dora AI is built using Privy.io for seamless and secure authentication, ensuring a smooth login experience. The Travel-to-Earn program is powered by Base, enabling users to earn crypto rewards for their travel activities. Additionally, the on-chain Dora AI agent runs on the Base Chain, providing decentralised intelligence and automation to enhance trip planning and reward distribution.
